title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・空に手を

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O defeats Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross in what the world dubs an upset victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet she's still not satisfied. If she wants to be Maruzensky's rival, there's still more growing and improving she has to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is overflowing with spirit and drive, and her eyes burn like a starving wolf. Maruzensky can't help but be enraptured by her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two promise to face off next year at a race with all the same conditions as the Japanese Derby: a 2,400-meter G1 turf race in Tokyo—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is determined to prove herself a worthy rival. We have to decide which race would be a good stepping stone towards her eventual showdown…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Goal Race is now the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to race in the Yasuda Kinen in order to improve Sakura Chiyono O's speed and help her defeat the Hot Rod!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Goal Race is now the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to race in the Takarazuka Kinen. Surely facing off against even stronger opponents will help improve her racing instincts!
